shellCommands.command: for f in /workspace/pages/404.js /workspace/pages/_app.js /workspace/pages/_document.js /workspace/pages/_error.js /workspace/pages/index.js /workspace/pages/blog/\[id\].js /workspace/pages/blog/index.js /workspace/components/AppProvider.js; do echo "=== $f ==="; cat "$f"; done
find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -maxdepth 2 -type d | sort; echo ---; find /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app -maxdepth 3 -name '*.md' | head -80
git -C /workspace show HEAD:pages/api/posts/index.js; echo '==== [id] ===='; git -C /workspace show 'HEAD:pages/api/posts/[id].js'

grep -n -B3 -A 25 'RouteContext\|Route Context Helper' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md | head -60; grep -n -A8 'NextResponse.json\|Response.json' /workspace/node_modules/next/dist/docs/01-app/03-api-reference/03-file-conventions/route.md | head -30
npx next typegen 2>&1 | tail -2 && npx tsc --noEmit && echo TSC-OK && npx next build 2>&1 | tail -25
